description: Pre-registered failure taxonomy codes for the Blinded Real-Listing Address Finder Pilot.

codes.description: No usable public clue could be extracted from the listing snapshot.
Street name could not be determined from any public signal.
Distance-signal lookup produced no actionable result.
DSQ (disambiguation/quantification) step failed to narrow candidates.
No spatial anchor (landmark, cross-street, neighbourhood centroid) available.
LLL model produced zero or all-invalid candidates.
None of the generated candidates could be resolved to a unique geocoded address.
Ground truth could not be established for this listing (used only in evaluation, never before freeze).
Listing was disqualified because the exact physical address was found in a public field.
Facade Checker returned no match above the acceptance threshold for TOP-3 candidates.
Facade Checker produced a false positive; candidate was rejected after cross-validation.
